fields.description: Ovelle is a collection of four and five bedroom villas at The Valley. Emaar’s proposal combines landscaped streets and outdoor recreation with homes arranged across three levels. The five-bedroom range includes Medium and Premium plans, with different internal areas, outdoor spaces and service-room arrangements.

overview: Ovelle’s design theme draws on the landscape of Emirati valleys, with earth-toned interiors, gardens and outdoor gathering places. The brochure describes open-plan rooms and terraces that extend daily life outside. Terrace Trails and Central Park form shared places for recreation, alongside more active play and sports settings. The villas offer a separate roof-level lounge and terrace, adding a second place to gather away from the principal living rooms. The proposed landscaping and recreational network should be checked against the delivery programme for the relevant phase.
research.locationNote: Emaar locates The Valley along Dubai–Al Ain Road. Ovelle’s fact sheet also describes connections through Jebel Ali–Lahbab Road towards Emirates Road and other districts. Dubai Outlet Mall and the Rugby Sevens are reference destinations in the launch material; travel times depend on the actual entrance, route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s current selection starts at AED 8,856,888, while the page retains a from-AED-7.09m headline. The launch sheet lists four-bedroom villas from AED 7.09m, five-bedroom Luxury villas from AED 8.85m and five-bedroom Premium villas from AED 13.2m. The plans call the middle category Medium. Confirm current unit pricing and availability.
research.paymentNote: The launch payment sheet allocates 10% on booking, seven further instalments of 10%, and 20% at estimated completion. Later stages are linked to 50%, 70% and 90% construction. Earlier calendar instalments have passed, so a current purchase requires an updated schedule.
research.handoverNote: December 2029 is the estimated completion month printed on the payment sheet and reported by Property Finder. It remains subject to the developer’s current programme and contractual terms.

facts.label: Launch collection and plots
facts.value: 133 villas: 61 four-bedroom, 45 five-bedroom Luxury and 27 five-bedroom Premium homes. Average plots are respectively 6,509, 7,077 and 8,724 sq ft; these are category averages, not a particular unit’s land area.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan BUA includes suite, parking, balcony and entrance/terrace components. It is not the same as internal floor area or plot size.

facts.label: Three-level arrangements
facts.value: Drawings show a lift, ground-floor guest bedroom and maid’s room, upper bedrooms and a roof lounge with pantry and terrace. Premium layouts also show a driver’s room and separate show kitchen. Pools and sunken seating are drawn, but inclusion and final specifications must be confirmed in the sale documents.

facts.label: Size comparison
facts.value: Some portal tables start the four-bedroom range around 4,355 sq ft. The official Type A drawing also includes a smaller 4,334.73 sq ft plan, retained separately here.
